info.name: HRMS API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) backend API.

**Base URL:** {{baseUrl}}

**Tech Stack:** Node.js + Express + TypeScript + MongoDB + JWT

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR, EMPLOYEE

---

## Quick Start
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your target environment:
   - **Local:** `http://localhost:5000/api`
   - **Production:** `https://human-resource-management-system-1-uwxr.onrender.com/api`
3. Run **Authentication > Login (Admin)** — the JWT token is saved automatically to the `token` variable.
4. All protected requests use `{{token}}` automatically.

## Demo Credentials
| Role | Email | Password |
|---|---|---|
| ADMIN | admin@hrms.com | Admin@123 |
| HR | hr@hrms.com | Hr@12345 |
| EMPLOYEE | (created via Admin/HR) | Default@123 |

item.name: Employees
item.description:
Employee management endpoints.

**Access:** ADMIN and HR only (all endpoints in this folder are protected by `authorize('ADMIN', 'HR')` middleware).

Employee IDs (`employeeId` string field like `EMP001`) are **auto-generated** by the backend — do not send them in POST requests.

The `department` field must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId referencing an existing Department.

**Employee Status Enum:** `ACTIVE` | `ON_LEAVE` | `TERMINATED` | `RESIGNED`

**Employment Type Enum:** `FULL_TIME` | `PART_TIME` | `CONTRACT` | `INTERN`

**Gender Enum:** `MALE` | `FEMALE` | `OTHER`

query.description: Filter by employee status. Enum: ACTIVE | ON_LEAVE | TERMINATED | RESIGNED
Search across firstName, lastName, employeeId, email, status fields

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of employees with department and user info populated.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Query parameters (all optional):**
- `status` — Filter by employee status enum value
- `department` — Filter by Department ObjectId
- `search` — Case-insensitive search across `firstName`, `lastName`, `employeeId`, `email`, `status`
- `page` — Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` — Results per page (default: 10)

**Response includes:** `{ employees: [...], pagination: { total, page, pages } }`

Fetches a single employee by their MongoDB `_id` with department and user info populated.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Path parameter:** `:id` — MongoDB ObjectId of the employee

exec: // Auto-save the newly created employee's _id to the employeeId variable
console.warn('⚠️  Could not extract employee _id from response.');

request.description:
Creates a new Employee record along with a linked User account.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Important notes from source code:**
- `employeeId` (string like `EMP001`) is **auto-generated** by the backend — do NOT include it in the request body.
- The backend creates both a `User` record and an `Employee` record atomically.
- `department` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId of an existing Department.
- If `password` is omitted, defaults to `Default@123`.
- If `role` is omitted, defaults to `EMPLOYEE`.
- `email` must be unique across all users.

**Required fields:** `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phone`, `designation`, `department`, `joiningDate`

**Optional fields:** `dateOfBirth`, `gender`, `address`, `employmentType` (default: `FULL_TIME`), `salary` (default: 0), `role`, `password`

**Gender enum:** `MALE` | `FEMALE` | `OTHER`

**Employment type enum:** `FULL_TIME` | `PART_TIME` | `CONTRACT` | `INTERN`

request.description:
Updates an existing employee's information.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Notes from source code:**
- `email` can be included to update the employee's email; the backend also updates the linked User record's email and checks for uniqueness.
- `employeeId` (auto-generated string) cannot be changed via this endpoint.
- `status` should be changed via `PATCH /:id/status` instead.
- All fields are optional — only include the fields you want to update.

Soft-deletes an employee by setting their status to `TERMINATED` and deactivating the linked User account (`isActive: false`).

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Note from source code:** This is a **soft deactivation** — the Employee and User records are NOT permanently deleted from the database. The employee's status becomes `TERMINATED` and the user can no longer log in.

Updates only the status field of an employee.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Status enum:** `ACTIVE` | `ON_LEAVE` | `TERMINATED` | `RESIGNED`

**Side effects from source code:**
- Setting `TERMINATED` or `RESIGNED` also deactivates the linked User account.
- Setting `ACTIVE` also reactivates the linked User account.

item.name: Departments
item.description:
Department management endpoints.

**GET endpoints:** Accessible by all authenticated users (ADMIN, HR, EMPLOYEE).

**POST / PUT / DELETE endpoints:** ADMIN only.

Department `manager` field is optional and references an Employee ObjectId.

request.description:
Returns all departments with `manager` (Employee firstName/lastName) populated.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR, EMPLOYEE (any authenticated user)

Returns a single department by MongoDB `_id`, along with a list of employees assigned to it.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR, EMPLOYEE

**Response includes:** `{ department: {...}, employees: [...] }`

exec: console.warn('⚠️  Could not extract department _id from response.');

request.description:
Creates a new Department.

**Roles:** ADMIN only

**Required fields:** `name` (must be unique)

**Optional fields:** `description`, `manager` (Employee ObjectId)

**Note:** `isActive` defaults to `true` and does not need to be sent.

Updates an existing department.

**Roles:** ADMIN only

**Updatable fields:** `name`, `description`, `manager` (Employee ObjectId), `isActive`

**Note:** `name` must remain unique across all departments. If you try to rename to an existing department name, you will get a 400 error.

Permanently deletes a department.

**Roles:** ADMIN only

**Important restriction from source code:** If any employees are currently assigned to this department, the request will fail with a 400 error: `Cannot delete department with assigned employees. Deactivate instead.`

You must either reassign employees to another department or use `PUT /departments/:id` with `isActive: false` to deactivate instead.

item.name: Attendance
item.description:
Attendance management endpoints.

**Check-In / Check-Out / Get My Attendance:** Any authenticated user (but the backend only processes requests for users who have an associated Employee record).

**Get All / Update / Delete Attendance:** ADMIN and HR only.

**Important from source code:**
- Check-in/check-out use IST (UTC+5:30) for date calculations.
- Check-in status is determined by comparing current time with the `lateCheckInTime` system setting (default: `09:30`).
- A unique compound index prevents duplicate attendance for the same employee and date.

**Status enum:** `PRESENT` | `ABSENT` | `LATE` | `HALF_DAY` | `LEAVE`

request.description:
Records a check-in for the authenticated employee.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**No request body required.** The backend derives the employee from `req.user._id`, calculates the IST date, and sets the check-in time to `new Date()` (server time).

**Business logic from source code:**
- Prevents duplicate check-in for the same IST calendar day.
- Status is `LATE` if current time > `lateCheckInTime` setting (default 09:30), otherwise `PRESENT`.

**Note:** ADMIN/HR users without an associated Employee record will receive a 404 error.

Records a check-out for the authenticated employee.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**No request body required.** The backend finds today's attendance record and sets `checkOut` to `new Date()`, calculating `totalHours` automatically.

**Business logic from source code:**
- Returns 400 if no check-in exists for today.
- Returns 400 if already checked out today.
- `totalHours` is calculated as `(checkOut - checkIn) / (1000 * 60 * 60)` rounded to 2 decimal places.

Returns all attendance records for the currently authenticated employee, sorted by date descending.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

item.name: Leaves
item.description:
Leave management endpoints.

**Apply for Leave / Get My Leaves:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**Get All Leaves / Approve / Reject:** ADMIN and HR only.

**Leave status lifecycle:** `PENDING` → `APPROVED` or `REJECTED`

**leaveType:** The field is a free-text `String` in the Mongoose schema — there is no enum constraint in the source code. Common values used in practice: `CASUAL`, `SICK`, `ANNUAL`, `MATERNITY`, `PATERNITY`, `UNPAID`.

**Business logic from source code:**
- Employees cannot approve or reject their own leave requests (403 error).
- Approving an active leave (current date falls within leave period) sets employee status to `ON_LEAVE`.
- Approval and rejection trigger email notifications to the employee.

request.description:
Submits a leave request for the authenticated employee.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**Required fields:** `leaveType`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `reason`

**Validation from source code:**
- `startDate` cannot be after `endDate`.
- Overlapping leave requests with `PENDING` or `APPROVED` status are rejected.

**leaveType:** Free-text string — no enum constraint in backend. Common values: `CASUAL`, `SICK`, `ANNUAL`, `MATERNITY`, `PATERNITY`, `UNPAID`

**Dates:** ISO date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`) format recommended.

Returns all leave requests for the authenticated employee, sorted by creation date descending.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

exec: // Save first pending leaveId if not already set
console.log('✅ leaveId saved from list:', jsonData.data[0]._id);

query.description: Filter by leave status. Enum: PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED

request.description:
Returns all leave requests from all employees, with employee and reviewer information populated.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Optional query parameters:**
- `status` — Filter by leave status: `PENDING` | `APPROVED` | `REJECTED`
- `employeeId` — MongoDB ObjectId to filter leaves for a specific employee

Approves a pending leave request.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**No request body required.**

**Business logic from source code:**
- Records `reviewedBy` (current user ObjectId) and `reviewedAt` (current timestamp).
- Sets leave `status` to `APPROVED`.
- If the leave period overlaps with today, sets the employee's status to `ON_LEAVE`.
- Sends an email notification to the employee.
- Returns 403 if the reviewer is the same employee who applied.

Rejects a pending leave request.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**No request body required.**

**Business logic from source code:**
- Records `reviewedBy` and `reviewedAt`.
- Sets leave `status` to `REJECTED`.
- Sends an email notification to the employee.
- Returns 403 if the reviewer is the same employee who applied.

item.name: Payroll
item.description:
Payroll management endpoints.

**Get My Payroll:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**All other endpoints:** ADMIN and HR only.

**Net Salary formula (calculated by backend):**
```
NetSalary = basicSalary + allowances + bonus - deductions - tax
```
`basicSalary` is automatically taken from the Employee's `salary` field — do NOT send `basicSalary` in the request body for creation.

**Payment status enum:** `PENDING` | `PAID`

**month field:** Full month name string (e.g. `August`, `September`) — matches JavaScript's `toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' })` output.

request.description:
Returns all payroll records for the authenticated employee, sorted by year and month descending.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

Creates a payroll record for a specific employee and month/year period.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Required fields:** `employee` (Employee ObjectId), `month` (full month name string), `year` (number)

**Optional fields (all default to 0):** `allowances`, `bonus`, `deductions`, `tax`

**Optional:** `paymentStatus` — `PENDING` (default) or `PAID`

**Important from source code:**
- Do NOT send `basicSalary` or `netSalary` — the backend fetches `basicSalary` from `employee.salary` and calculates `netSalary` automatically.
- A duplicate payroll for the same `employee + month + year` combination will return a 400 error.
- Sending `paymentStatus: 'PAID'` will also set `paymentDate` to the current timestamp.
- `month` should be the full English month name as returned by JavaScript's `Date.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' })`, e.g., `January`, `February`, ..., `December`.

**Type enum:** `PUBLIC` | `COMPANY` | `OPTIONAL`

item.name: Dashboard
item.description:
Dashboard data endpoints.

**Admin Dashboard:** ADMIN and HR only (returns company-wide workforce metrics).

**Employee Dashboard:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

request.description:
Returns company-wide HR metrics for the Admin/HR dashboard.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR

**Response data includes:**
- `totalEmployees` — Count of users with EMPLOYEE role
- `activeEmployees` — Count with status ACTIVE
- `totalDepartments` — Count of active departments
- `presentToday` — Employees checked in today (IST)
- `absentToday` — Active employees who haven't checked in today
- `pendingLeaves` — Count of PENDING leave requests
- `payrollSummary` — Current month/year total net salary paid

Returns a personalized dashboard for the authenticated employee.

**Roles:** Any authenticated user with an associated Employee record.

**Response data includes:**
- `employee` — Basic profile (firstName, lastName, designation, department)
- `todayAttendance` — Today's attendance record or null
- `pendingLeaves` — Count of the employee's PENDING leave requests
- `recentLeaves` — Last 3 leave requests
- `recentAttendance` — Last 5 attendance records
- `currentPayroll` — Current month/year payroll record or null

**Note:** ADMIN/HR users without an associated Employee record will receive a 404.

item.name: Settings
item.description:
System settings endpoints.

**GET /settings:** All authenticated users.

**PUT /settings:** ADMIN only.

**Settings fields:**
- `companyName` — Company display name (default: `My Company`)
- `lateCheckInTime` — Time string `HH:MM` used by attendance check-in to determine LATE status (default: `09:30`)

request.description:
Returns the global system settings. Creates a default settings document if none exists.

**Roles:** ADMIN, HR, EMPLOYEE (any authenticated user)

**Response data includes:** `companyName`, `lateCheckInTime`

Updates the global system settings. Creates a new settings document if none exists.

**Roles:** ADMIN only

**Updatable fields:**
- `companyName` — Company display name string
- `lateCheckInTime` — Time in `HH:MM` 24-hour format (e.g., `09:30`). This is used by the check-in logic to determine if an employee is LATE.
